{{Quote|Yo, Gusha! Where'd my ''pateesa'' go?''"<br />"''Left with a pale-haired human female&mdash;was draped all over her.|Jariah Syn and Gusha|<ref name="l38" />}}
'''Gusha''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-[[Hair/Legends|furred]], red-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]]<ref name="l38" /> whose name translated from [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] as "Lucky."<ref name="l38 letters">[[Legacy (2006) 38|''Legacy'' (2006) 38]] {{C|letters section}}</ref> As the owner and [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] of the [[Gusha's Luck]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], Gusha was on-duty<ref name="l38" /> in [[137 ABY]]<ref name="TPBDate">''[[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 8: Tatooine]]'' dates its events to 133 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates Vader's death to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the events of ''Volume 8'', which include Grusha's appearance, must take place in [[137 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jariah Syn]] were seated at the bar.<ref name="l38" />

After Syn left, Gusha poured two [[Corellian ale/Legends|Corellian ales]] for the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] agent [[Gunn Yage]] and Skywalker, followed by two glasses of [[Merenzane Gold/Legends|Merenzane Gold]]. Yage spiked Skywalker's glass with a tranquilizer to briefly knock Skywalker [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]] and disorient him, then claimed to Gusha that Skywalker drank too much. She told Gusha to keep the change to "buy the missus a little something" before she took her prey elsewhere. When Syn returned shortly thereafter, Gusha told the co-pilot of the events that had transpired in his absence. The bartender wore a dirty white [[shirt]] with brown shoulderpads and brown [[Clothing/Legends|pants]].<ref name="l38" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gusha appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 38|thirty-eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="l38" /> on [[July 29]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54410/star_wars_legacy_2006_38|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #38}}</ref> A glossary included in the issue's letters section indicates that the Huttese word "gusha" translates to "lucky" in Basic, meaning that the name of Gusha's cantina could be called "Lucky's Luck."<ref name="l38 letters" />
